questions.question: What is the scope of an Organizational Change Management (OCM) Community Champion?

options.text: Technical development and coding
Advocating for change adoption and supporting end users within their department
Managing server infrastructure
Approving budget requests

explanation.correct: OCM Community Champions advocate for change adoption within their departments, support end users during transitions, provide feedback to the project team, and help drive user engagement with new platform capabilities. Reference: CPOA exam blueprint - People domain

wrongAnswers.explanation: Technical development is handled by developers, not OCM Champions
Infrastructure management is an IT operations function
Budget approval is typically a finance or management function

source.excerpt: Identify the scope of an OCM Community Champion.

questions.question: IT and Security departments are coming with conflicting applications and tools. How should the Platform Owner resolve this issue?

options.text: Choose the IT department's solution automatically
Facilitate a governance meeting to evaluate requirements and reach consensus
Implement both solutions separately
Delay all decisions indefinitely

explanation.correct: The Platform Owner should facilitate a governance meeting bringing together stakeholders from both departments to evaluate requirements, understand constraints, and reach consensus on a solution that serves organizational needs. Reference: CPOA exam blueprint - People domain

wrongAnswers.explanation: Favoring one department without evaluation creates conflict and suboptimal outcomes
Implementing duplicate solutions wastes resources and creates inconsistency
Indefinite delays prevent progress and don't resolve conflicts

source.excerpt: Given an IT and Security department are coming with conflicting applications/tools, identify how the platform owner should resolve the issue.

questions.question: A project needs to be completed and requires technical expertise in ServiceNow development. Which certification shows an individual is prepared to complete this work?

options.text: Certified System Administrator (CSA)
Certified Application Developer (CAD)
Certified Platform Owner Associate (CPOA)
Certified Implementation Specialist - ITSM

explanation.correct: The Certified Application Developer (CAD) certification validates technical development skills including scripting, GlideRecord, business rules, and application development - the skills needed for ServiceNow development work. Reference: CPOA exam blueprint - People domain

wrongAnswers.explanation: CSA is for administration, not development
CPOA is for platform ownership and governance, not development
CIS-ITSM is for ITSM implementation, not development

source.excerpt: Given a scenario about a project that needs to be completed, identify the certification that will show an individual is prepared to complete the work.

questions.question: Which factors should be considered when developing a communication plan for a ServiceNow implementation? (Choose two.)

options.text: Stakeholder groups and their information needs
Office furniture requirements
Communication channels and frequency
Parking allocation

explanation.correct: Key factors for a communication plan include identifying stakeholder groups and their information needs, plus determining appropriate communication channels (email, meetings, newsletters) and frequency. Reference: CPOA exam blueprint - People domain

wrongAnswers.explanation: Office furniture is unrelated to communication planning
Parking allocation is not a communication plan factor

source.excerpt: Identify the factors to consider of a communication plan.

questions.question: Which type of supplier should be engaged when an organization lacks internal expertise or capacity for a specific ServiceNow implementation area?

options.text: Hardware vendor
ServiceNow partner or consulting firm
Recruitment agency
Office supplies vendor

explanation.correct: ServiceNow partners and consulting firms provide specialized expertise and capacity for implementation work. They can fill gaps in internal skills and accelerate project delivery through their experience. Reference: CPOA exam blueprint - People domain

wrongAnswers.explanation: Hardware vendors don't provide ServiceNow expertise
Recruitment agencies help hire permanent staff, not fill immediate expertise gaps
Office supplies vendors are unrelated to ServiceNow expertise

source.excerpt: Given a scenario about a supplier, identify the type of supplier that is needed to solve for the gap in expertise or time.

questions.question: An organization wants to implement knowledge management effectively. How should knowledge management be conducted?

options.text: Allow anyone to publish articles without review
Establish a governance process with article lifecycle, reviews, and ownership
Store all knowledge in spreadsheets
Limit knowledge access to IT staff only

explanation.correct: Effective knowledge management requires a governance process including article lifecycle management, review workflows, clear ownership, and quality standards. This ensures accurate, up-to-date knowledge is available to users. Reference: CPOA exam blueprint - People domain

wrongAnswers.explanation: Unrestricted publishing leads to inaccurate or duplicate content
Spreadsheets lack searchability and governance features
Knowledge should be accessible to those who need it, not just IT

source.excerpt: Given a scenario about an organization and knowledge management, identify how knowledge management should be conducted.

questions.question: What potential issue might cause sponsorship engagement to not be successful?

options.text: Executive sponsor actively participates in steering committees
Sponsor lacks authority or commitment to drive organizational change
Sponsor communicates the project vision regularly
Sponsor removes roadblocks for the project team

explanation.correct: Sponsorship engagement fails when the sponsor lacks authority to make decisions, commitment to drive change, or availability to support the project. Effective sponsors need organizational power and active engagement. Reference: CPOA exam blueprint - People domain

wrongAnswers.explanation: Active participation in steering committees is positive for sponsorship
Regular communication supports successful sponsorship
Removing roadblocks is a key sponsor responsibility

source.excerpt: Given a scenario about sponsorship engagement, identify any potential issues that will cause the sponsorship engagement to not be successful, and why.

questions.question: An organization needs to find information about ServiceNow partners and their capabilities. Where should they look?

options.text: ServiceNow Partner Portal
YouTube
Wikipedia
Social media

explanation.correct: The ServiceNow Partner Portal provides information about certified partners, their specializations, customer reviews, and capabilities. It's the official source for finding qualified implementation partners. Reference: CPOA exam blueprint - People domain

wrongAnswers.explanation: YouTube may have videos but isn't the official partner directory
Wikipedia isn't an authoritative source for partner information
Social media isn't a reliable source for verified partner information

source.excerpt: Given a scenario about ServiceNow partners, identify a need for the partner or how to find the partner information that is needed.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of OCM (Organizational Change Management) Community Champions in a ServiceNow implementation?

options.text: To write all the technical code
To drive adoption and serve as change advocates within their departments
To manage server infrastructure
To handle billing and procurement

explanation.correct: OCM Community Champions drive platform adoption within their departments by acting as change advocates, communicating benefits, gathering feedback, and helping colleagues through transitions. They bridge the gap between IT and business users.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Code development is handled by developers, not OCM Champions
Infrastructure is managed by IT operations, not Champions
Billing and procurement are handled by finance/purchasing teams

source.excerpt: OCM Champions drive adoption within departments as change advocates

questions.question: Which ServiceNow certifications are appropriate for team members who need to develop custom applications? (Choose two.)

options.text: Certified Application Developer (CAD)
Certified System Administrator (CSA)
Certified Implementation Specialist - ITSM
None - certifications aren't needed for development

explanation.correct: CAD (Certified Application Developer) validates advanced development skills including scripting, APIs, and custom applications. CSA (Certified System Administrator) provides foundational platform knowledge essential for any developer. Both certifications together ensure developers have comprehensive skills.

wrongAnswers.explanation: CIS-ITSM focuses on IT Service Management implementation, not application development
Certifications validate skills and are recommended for professional development

source.excerpt: Match certifications to project needs - CAD for development, CSA for administration

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of a ServiceNow Center of Excellence (CoE) staffing model?

options.text: To outsource all ServiceNow work
To define the roles, skills, and team structure needed to effectively manage and grow the platform
To reduce the number of ServiceNow licenses needed
To eliminate the need for external partners

explanation.correct: A CoE staffing model ensures the right mix of roles (administrators, developers, architects, process owners) and skills are in place to manage, maintain, and evolve the platform.

wrongAnswers.explanation: A CoE typically combines internal and external resources, not full outsourcing
Staffing models don't directly affect licensing requirements
Partners often complement internal CoE capabilities

questions.question: An organization is rolling out ServiceNow to 5,000 new users. Which OCM activity should be prioritized FIRST?

options.text: Building a custom mobile app
Conducting a stakeholder impact assessment to understand how the change affects different user groups
Purchasing additional server capacity
Creating detailed technical documentation

explanation.correct: A stakeholder impact assessment identifies how different user groups will be affected by the change, enabling targeted communication, training, and support plans.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Mobile apps are a feature consideration, not an OCM priority
Server capacity is an infrastructure concern, not OCM
Technical docs are important but come after understanding stakeholder impacts

questions.question: Which ServiceNow resource provides structured learning paths and certifications for platform team members?

options.text: ServiceNow Community forums
Now Learning platform
ServiceNow Developer portal
HI Service Portal

explanation.correct: Now Learning is ServiceNow's official training platform providing structured courses, learning paths, and certification preparation for all ServiceNow roles.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Community forums provide peer support but not structured learning paths
Developer portal provides tools and documentation, not formal training
HI portal is for instance management and support, not training

source.excerpt: Identify training resources for platform teams

questions.question: A Platform Owner notices that users are submitting requests through email instead of the Service Portal. What is the MOST likely root cause?

options.text: The email system is faster than ServiceNow
Users lack adequate training or the portal doesn't meet their usability expectations
ServiceNow doesn't support the request types
The network is blocking portal access

explanation.correct: Low portal adoption typically stems from insufficient user training or a portal experience that doesn't meet user expectations. Addressing UX and training drives adoption.

wrongAnswers.explanation: ServiceNow portal is typically faster for structured requests than email
Most request types can be configured in ServiceNow
Network issues would affect all ServiceNow access, not just the portal

questions.question: What is the recommended approach for building a ServiceNow skills pipeline within an organization?

options.text: Hire only experienced ServiceNow professionals externally
Combine internal upskilling through Now Learning with strategic external hiring and partner engagement
Wait for ServiceNow to provide free on-site training
Assign ServiceNow work only to IT staff

explanation.correct: A balanced approach combining internal training via Now Learning, strategic hiring for specialized roles, and partner engagement for capacity or expertise gaps creates a sustainable skills pipeline.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Relying solely on external hiring is expensive and creates dependency
Organizations must proactively invest in training their teams
ServiceNow extends beyond IT; business teams also need skills

questions.question: What is the recommended staffing model for a mature ServiceNow Center of Excellence (CoE)?

options.text: A single administrator handling all platform functions
A cross-functional team with Platform Owner, architects, developers, and business analysts
External consultants exclusively with no internal team
Only IT operations staff with no dedicated platform roles

explanation.correct: A mature CoE includes a cross-functional team: Platform Owner for strategy, architects for design, developers for implementation, and business analysts for requirements — ensuring sustainable platform growth.

wrongAnswers.explanation: A single administrator cannot sustain a mature platform; it creates a single point of failure
Relying solely on external consultants prevents knowledge retention and sustainable operations
Dedicated platform roles are essential for a mature CoE

questions.question: Which organizational change management approach is recommended when rolling out new ServiceNow capabilities?

options.text: Deploy first, train later when users report issues
Engage stakeholders early, provide role-based training, and establish champion networks
Send a single email announcement to all users
Restrict access until all users complete certification

explanation.correct: Effective change management involves early stakeholder engagement, tailored role-based training programs, and champion networks to drive adoption and reduce resistance.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Reactive training leads to poor adoption and user frustration
Email alone is insufficient for effective change management
Blocking access is impractical and creates operational disruption
